value.title: F275 final: shared kind-before-sender contract costs no real-path work

sections.name: body
sections.value:
F275 final headc515a66 changes only FakeQueue and the shared queue_contract, not any real-adapter source. The fake borrows before mutation, checks recipient/kind FIRST, then sender, then removes/fails/records. Misfiled rows therefore stay untouched; own-kind sender-less rows terminalize and free the successor. Valid fake path keeps the old one borrowed lookup plus one removal; no extra lookup/whole-job clone/SQL/worker. Sources:fakes.rs:1554-1582; contract.rs:1373-1444.

Both testkit/tests/contract_over_fakes.rs:61-63 and store/tests/queue.rs:41-43 run that contract. Exact-head CI44934137381/job136936972357/artifact14718966611:2838 cases, zero failed/error/skipped; both contract runners, terminal-refusal witnesses and all six spawn guards passed. R2 cost PASS carries R1; no new cost notes. No local M2/comparison/build or live window; C25 quick gate remains dependency-red.

magicWand: validation-order and no-mutation assertions belong in the shared fake/real contract, rather than independent tests that can drift.
